subject: flamingo
title: A Dead Flamingo Can Stand on One Leg. Scientists Tested It

scenes.text: A dead flamingo can stand on one leg.
Live flamingos balance like this for hours, even dozing. Everyone assumed it took serious muscle.
So in 2017, Georgia Tech researchers lifted a dead flamingo's leg into the pose. It stayed put by itself.
Almost no muscle work. The bird's own weight holds the leg steady.
The leg works like a sling, not a lock, so the pose costs almost no energy.
So a dead flamingo can stand on one leg. The pose needs almost no effort.

description:
A dead flamingo can stand on one leg.
Georgia Tech researchers found the pose needs little or no muscle, because the leg holds the body up passively.
Would you have guessed it? Comment below.
